entries.title: 3D 打印外壳

entries.title: 3D 打印外壳迭代版
entries.description: 作为第二个外部 3D 打印外壳入口，用于查看原始页面与图片。

entries.imageAlt: 3D 打印外壳迭代版的外观预览

entries.title: 3D 打印底座
entries.description: 用于展示与无线麦使用场景相关的外部 3D 打印底座项目。
entries.descriptionEn: An external 3D-printed base project related to SayAll App use cases.

entries.title: 3D 打印带壳适配底座
entries.description: 为安装 3D 打印外壳后的遥控器提供直立放置方案。
entries.descriptionEn: A stand designed to hold the remote while its 3D-printed shell is attached.
entries.imageAlt: 3D 打印带壳适配底座的实物预览

entries.title: 3D 打印倾斜底座
entries.description: 原始页面标题为「小米蓝牙遥控器2底座」，用于查看倾斜底座项目的原始页面。
entries.descriptionEn: An external 3D-printed base that holds the remote at a tilt, with its original page and photos.
entries.imageAlt: 3D 打印倾斜底座的实物预览

entries.title: 3D 打印 Apple TV 遥控器底座
entries.description: 原始页面为 Apple TV 遥控器底座项目，用于查看一体成型底座的原始页面。
entries.descriptionEn: An external one-piece 3D-printed base project, with its original page and photos.
entries.imageAlt: 3D 打印 Apple TV 遥控器底座的实物预览
entries.imageAltEn: Preview of the 3D-printed Apple TV remote base

entries.title: 3D 打印 2 Pro 倾斜底座
entries.description: 原始页面标题为「小米蓝牙遥控器2Pro 倾斜底座」，用于查看 75 度倾斜底座项目的原始页面。
entries.descriptionEn: An external 75-degree tilted base for the Xiaomi Bluetooth Remote 2 Pro, with its original page and photos.
entries.imageAlt: 3D 打印 2 Pro 倾斜底座的实物预览
entries.imageAltEn: Preview of the 3D-printed 2 Pro tilted base

entries.title: 3D 打印 2 Pro 保护壳
entries.description: 原始页面标题为「小米遥控器 2 Pro 保护壳｜防滑防摔方格纹理全包壳」，原始页面标注适配小米遥控器 2 Pro。
entries.descriptionEn: A full-coverage case with a grid texture for the Xiaomi Remote 2 Pro, with its original page and photos.
entries.imageAlt: 3D 打印 2 Pro 保护壳的实物预览

entries.title: 3D 打印 2 代保护壳收纳
entries.description: 原始页面标题为「【小米遥控器 2】保护壳收纳」，原始页面标注适用于小米蓝牙遥控器 2（非 2 Pro），并说明底座需用双面胶固定、需安装 6 颗 5×2 磁铁。
entries.descriptionEn: A case storage project for the Xiaomi Bluetooth Remote 2 (not 2 Pro) that needs adhesive mounting and magnets.
entries.imageAlt: 3D 打印 2 代保护壳收纳的实物预览

entries.title: 3D 打印 2 代低重心底座
entries.description: 原始页面标题同为「小米蓝牙遥控器2底座」，作者为解决轻底座易翻倒问题重新绘制，重量约 15.17 克。
entries.descriptionEn: A redrawn base for the Xiaomi Bluetooth Remote 2 that resists tipping, weighing about 15.17 g.
entries.imageAlt: 3D 打印 2 代低重心底座的实物预览

entries.title: 3D 打印 DJI Mic 2 组合支架
entries.description: 原始页面标题为「小米2Pro DJI Mic2 打破语音1分钟限制」，展示把 DJI Mic 2 固定在小米蓝牙遥控器 2 Pro 上的打印支架。
entries.descriptionEn: A printed mount that attaches a DJI Mic 2 to the Xiaomi Bluetooth Remote 2 Pro, with its original page and photos.
entries.imageAlt: 3D 打印 DJI Mic 2 组合支架的实物预览
entries.imageAltEn: Preview of the 3D-printed DJI Mic 2 combo mount

entries.title: 3D 打印桌面设备收纳底座
entries.description: 原始页面标题为「vibe coding设备收纳底座小米遥控器 2 ProAI Passport」，原始页面标注可同时收纳小米蓝牙遥控器 2 Pro、小米 27 英寸显示器遥控器、AirPods Pro 2 与 AI Passport，并计划后续增加 AirPods Pro 2 充电位。
entries.descriptionEn: A desktop base that stores the Xiaomi Bluetooth Remote 2 Pro, a Xiaomi monitor remote, AirPods Pro 2, and an AI Passport.
entries.imageAlt: 3D 打印桌面设备收纳底座的实物预览
entries.imageAltEn: Preview of the 3D-printed desktop device organizer

entries.title: 3D 打印大哥大外壳
entries.description: 把小米蓝牙遥控器 2 Pro 装入复古手持电话造型的外壳项目，用于查看原始页面与图片。
entries.descriptionEn: A retro handset shell that holds the Xiaomi Bluetooth Remote 2 Pro, with its original page and photos.
entries.imageAlt: 3D 打印大哥大外壳的实物预览
